title: A longer optical path
hook: Change geometric path length and predict optical path length.
misconception: optical path length stays fixed when geometric path length doubles.
objective: Apply OPL = nL to compare optical path length when geometric path length changes, under the stated assumptions.

claims.text: With a uniform transparent medium with fixed refractive index, OPL = nL. When geometric path length doubles, optical path length becomes 2 times its original value.
claims.source: Idealized model OPL = nL; scaling exponent 1. Physics and assumptions await independent review.

recall.question: Consider a uniform transparent medium with fixed refractive index, with a nonzero initial result. If geometric path length triples from a positive value, what is the multiplier on optical path length?
recall.why: Apply OPL = nL under the same assumptions: the multiplier is 3.
